body:
## Context

GitHub issue #233, verified live on main: runExternal at packages/cli/lib/dispatch.mjs:146-154 passes bare 'npx' into runChild, which spawns with {stdio:'inherit'} and no shell/.cmd handling (:82). On win32 that is ENOENT (Node does no PATHEXT resolution for non-shell spawn), and npx.cmd alone hits the CVE-2024-27980 refusal — so `adlc review` is unreachable on Windows, misreported as a missing package. `review` is the only external verb, so the surface is contained.

DESIGN CONSTRAINT (adjacency with #421, decided up front): do NOT reach for shell:true — it introduces &/| re-parsing of user-supplied args and conflicts with the PATH-trust direction. Preferred fix: resolve the npx binary NEXT TO the running node executable (join(dirname(process.execPath), process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npx.cmd' : 'npx')), falling back to bare 'npx' only when the sibling does not exist. On win32, spawn the resolved .cmd the supported way for the Node version in use (post-CVE-2024-27980 Node requires shell for .cmd — if that forces shell:true, pass the resolved ABSOLUTE path and pre-quote/validate argv, and say so in the PR body; an alternative is spawning `node <abs-path-to-npx-cli.js>` which needs no shell at all — evaluate both and pick with evidence).

CI cannot catch regressions here: the only Windows matrix (ticket-store-platform.yml) never exercises @adlc/cli. The tests must therefore be platform-BRANCH assertions runnable on Linux (inject platform + execPath, assert the exact spawn shape).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Platform-branch unit tests (runnable on Linux) assert the resolved command + argv shape for win32 AND posix, including the fallback when no sibling npx exists. verify: `node --test packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0 with the new tests present.
2. Non-Windows behavior is byte-compatible for the happy path (still resolves the same npx when the sibling exists; existing cli tests green). verify: same suite.
3. The chosen win32 mechanism is documented in the PR body with the CVE-2024-27980 reasoning and the shell-quoting posture (no unvalidated user text through a shell). verify: reviewer confirms; if shell:true is used anywhere, a test pins that argv is the pre-validated form.
4. Package suite + mutation gate green. verify: `node --test packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs` exits 0 and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main` exits 0.
title: cli: make `adlc review` reachable on Windows — resolve npx beside the node executable, never bare-spawn (#233)
